title: Arithmetic Nature of Delocalized Eta Invariants
exact_target: Which numbers can delocalized spectral-asymmetry invariants take, and must they always be algebraic?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003894 (OWR-16407-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Non-commutative Geometry, Index Theory and Mathematical Physics (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/32, pp. 1911--1981. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 12.
Xie--Yu, IMRN (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The group, conjugacy class, operator and convergence hypotheses are essential to define the invariant. The source does not ask for algebraicity of divergent or undefined expressions, and the general value question is broader than the highlighted algebraicity question.
